capabilities: Answer questions about the current note or selection with @ mentions and saved conversations
Generate and render checked Mermaid diagrams from note content
Apply AI edits through diff previews, Insert, or New note
Connect MCP servers and approve each tool call with full arguments shown
Run built-in and custom workflow prompts, including summaries and flashcards
disambiguation: Not an autonomous vault-wide agent; it works on the open note or selection and writes to notes only after explicit approval.
extras: Desktop only (no mobile support). The plugin itself is free; AI usage is billed directly by the chosen provider, or runs free on a local model. Detailed docs live on a separate docs site.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant for asking questions about the open note and applying AI-suggested edits with user-controlled, diff-previewed writes.

relations.evidence: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, OpenRouter, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, or a local OpenAI-compatible server.
Using a local model such as Ollama? Check the address, leave the model empty
paste the mcpServers JSON from Claude Desktop, Cursor or VS Code to import
Every diagram is parsed and rendered with the Mermaid that ships in Obsidian

requires.name: AI provider API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Azure, OpenRouter)
Paid OpenAI API account for image generation

summary: AI sidebar that answers questions about the current note, renders Mermaid diagrams, calls approved MCP tools, and applies edits only after review.
